cacheHint.note: cache by the JCS-canonical policy_parameters hash only; never by wall-clock or session

description: Completes ONE step of a checklist/SOP run and returns its OCG v0.4 step receipt: execution_hash chains to prev_step_receipt_digest (pass the previous step's execution_hash, or omit for step 0). A blocking-gate step with evidence_requirement != "none" and no evidence supplied is refused (the caller enforces step order; this tool enforces the evidence requirement per step). Call once per step in order, then pass the full ordered list of returned receipts to checklist_verify_run to check the chain and mint the run receipt.

completer_key.description: Identifier of who/what completed the step (e.g. an agent id). Never real PII.

evidence.description: Evidence payload, e.g. { text_digest }, { file_sha256 }, or { attestation_digest }. Required unless evidence_requirement is "none".

prev_step_receipt_digest.description: execution_hash of the previous step's receipt. Omit for the first step in the run.

step.description: The step object from the definition's steps[] array being completed.

approver_role.description: Role required to approve this step, if any.

evidence_requirement.description: What evidence this step requires before it can be completed.

gate.description: Whether this step blocks the next step until completed (blocking) or can be skipped (advisory).

instruction.description: The step's instruction text (for the receipt narrative; not hashed separately from the step object).

step_id.description: The step's unique id within the definition, e.g. "s1".

step_index.description: Zero-based index of this step in the definition.

name: checklist_step_receipt
title: Mint a hash-chained checklist step receipt
